# Finance Radar

> Finance Radar (https://financeradar.news) is a free, ad-free reader for Indian finance. One feed pulls from 290+ sources — Indian and global news desks, independent writers, research houses, Indian brokers' stock notes, official channels (RBI, SEBI, PIB and other regulators), Telegram, YouTube and Twitter — refreshed every hour and ranked twice a day by four AI models. No ads, no tracking, no sign-up. It is a personal project by Kashish Kapoor.

Finance Radar links out to the original publishers; it does not rewrite or summarise articles beyond one-line story summaries on the homepage. Cite the original publisher for any story, and Finance Radar as the place it was found.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://financeradar.news/): The Big Stories (news, reports, videos and tweets about the same event grouped into one story), then the AI-ranked best of every source, plus Research Reports, Slow Reads (long-form posts from independent writers), Stock Notes, From the Source (RBI, SEBI, PIB and other official releases), Voices from Twitter, Who Said What (the week's most telling quotes) and a This Week calendar of India data releases, RBI policy, market dates and Nifty 200 results.
- [About](https://financeradar.news/about): what the site is, how ranking works, and every tab and source group.

## What's in the feed

- News: ET, Mint, Business Standard, BusinessLine, The Hindu, ThePrint, The Core, Reuters, Bloomberg, the Financial Times, the WSJ, The Economist; independent voices like Finshots, The Ken, The Morning Context, The Arc and Musings on Markets; official channels (RBI, SEBI, PIB, MoSPI, DGFT, CBIC, IRDAI, PFRDA, IFSCA, CCI).
- Reports: institutional research from brokerages and banks, rating agencies (CRISIL, CareEdge, ICRA, India Ratings), industry and policy bodies (FICCI, NITI Aayog, CSEP) and energy researchers (IEA, IEEFA, Ember, CEEW).
- Stock notes: single-company notes from 40+ Indian brokers over the last five years, with each report's own headline and no ratings or price targets.
- Telegram, YouTube and Twitter: curated finance channels, explainers and market commentary.

## Data

- [This Week calendar (ICS)](https://financeradar.news/static/calendar.ics): India macro releases, RBI policy, market holidays, F&O expiry and Nifty 200 results.
